{{Quote|Who are you? Is that my&mdash;? We lifted that cargo from the wreck of the Sun Ranger! Old ship was a deathtrap.|Mak Torvu|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''''Sun Ranger''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that at some point crashed on the [[Horizon Island]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. A local named [[Mak Torvu]] and his associates tried to search the wreckage for cargo, but were ambushed by the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who turned the ship into a deathtrap.
